name: manage-segments
description: Create, inspect, and maintain Harness FME segments (STANDARD, LARGE, RULE_BASED). Manage metadata, select type-specific definition and membership workflows, and check referencing flags before every mutation. Use when asked to create a segment, add keys to a segment, list segments, update segment metadata, remove keys, replace keys, check segment usage, or delete segments. Do not use for making a flag USE a segment (update-flag-targeting), flag CRUD (create-feature-flag, manage-flag-lifecycle), or flag discovery (discover-feature-flags). Trigger phrases: create segment, add keys, list segments, segment membership, segment targeting, update segment, remove keys, replace segment keys, segment definition, check segment usage, delete segment.
